description: Give Codex sessions a local Lares companion.

interface.shortDescription: Give Codex sessions a local Live2D companion.
interface.longDescription: Lares turns a Codex session into a continuously animated desktop character — a Lar. Lifecycle hooks provide the baseline heartbeat; first-person MCP emotes drive feeling. Nothing leaves the machine, and Lares never reads transcripts or guesses sentiment.
